query_lineage.sql: SELECT s.record_id,s.entry_id,s.payload,d.domains,d.code,l.lemma,l.pos,l.gloss FROM source_observations s JOIN definition_states d ON d.entry_id=s.entry_id JOIN lexemes l ON l.id=d.lexeme_id WHERE s.source='wordnet_hierarchy' AND s.scope='lexical' ORDER BY s.record_id
query_lineage.membership: any(exact_ancestor_synset_id in path for path in source_record.features.hypernym_paths)
query_lineage.counting: Rows are exact entry/source records; unique_synsets deduplicates features.synset_name; branches may overlap because WordNet has multiple inheritance. Inclusive counts admit the root itself if present.
query_lineage.hash: SHA256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON with sorted keys, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(comma,colon)

scope_findings.statement: No sign is approved, filled, or promoted by this inventory. All unresolved domains remain unchanged.

All56 distinct linear-unit definitions and complete example lists were read. No explicit wanting/refusal predicate was observed in them; that is a scoped reading, not a causal warrant or independent gold.
The broad808-entry parent population was measured; an oversized broad-definition output was truncated. No claim of complete519-definition semantic review is made.
133 linear entries share56 native synsets. A holdout split by entry_id alone can put aliases of the same source definition in both sets. Native synset identity must be visible to the audit designer.

Native linear ancestry includes mesh.n.01 (openings per linear inch), fistmele.n.01 (correct bow-string distance), and footer/miler/yarder combinatorial lengths. These are scope stress cases, not established WANT counterexamples.

The broader parent includes208 monetary synsets, a pain-intensity unit dol.n.01, injury-based radiation unit rem.n.02, and tennis advantage.n.02. These require their own bounded audit if that parent scope is proposed.

WordNet ancestry is attached to the exact entry and synset. It admits foot.n.02 but excludes foot body-part/verb senses; admits scruple.n.01 but excludes uneasiness/moral-inhibition/hesitation senses. The complete homograph records are included for inspection.
